messages:
marco_fin: Noticed an unexpected shift: nightly auto-scale bumped dedicated GPU hours for 'enterprise-batch' and the cost was split across three billing projects. Need a quick reconciliation before invoices.

olga_finops: How big is the delta? Any customer-facing invoices impacted?

chris_cloud: Preliminary: ~$9,200 in the last billing window. Most of it looks like the autoscaler created ephemeral VMs without the `customer_id` tag; our allocation falls back to project-level mapping which is inconsistent.

alertbot: INFO: gpu_budget_alert triggered for billing_account: dedicated-reserve (value:$9200, threshold:$8000) :warning:

ops_platform: We recently rolled a change to autoscaler metadata propagation; it missed the tag sync step on scale-up. I can push a hotfix to add tags in the boot script and backfill metadata for active hosts.

marco_fin: Please backfill and produce two reports: one showing the current (pre-backfill) allocation, one after metadata backfill. Finance wants to see before/after to decide crediting.

olga_finops: Also add a column `allocation_method` with values [explicit_tag, fallback_project]. Filter rows where fallback_project != null. If any single customer's misallocation > $2k, we flag for manual review.

chris_cloud: Will run backfill + diff tonight. ETA report by 8am PT. I'll also add a short-lived budget override so the next day's alerts don't page on the known delta.

alertbot: NOTE: budget_override created for billing_account dedicated-reserve until 2026-06-02.

marco_fin: Thanks—schedule a 9:30am PT sync tomorrow for sign-off if the misallocations persist.
